h1: Pakistan tourist visa from the UK
intro: Planning a holiday or a visit to family or friends in Pakistan? This page explains the Pakistan tourist visa, who needs one and what to prepare. We check the rules for your passport and apply for you.
eligibility: You are travelling for a holiday, sightseeing or to visit family or friends
You won’t work or do business during your visit
You have a return ticket and enough money for your stay

sections.heading: Do you need a Pakistan tourist visa?
sections.text: British passport holders need a visa to visit Pakistan, applied for online through Pakistan's official online visa system.

sections.heading: What a Pakistan tourist visa covers
sections.text: A Pakistan tourist visa is for holidays, sightseeing and visiting family or friends in Pakistan. It doesn't cover business meetings or paid work. If you're travelling for business, see our [Pakistan business visa](/pakistan-business-visa-uk/) page.

sections.heading: UK residents on other passports
sections.text: British citizens of Pakistani origin may be able to use a NICOP or POC card instead of a visa. UK residents on other passports apply online, unless their nationality has different rules.

sections.heading: Pakistan tourist visa help from Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and handle Pakistan tourist visa applications for travellers across the UK, entirely online. Before you travel, read the UK government's [foreign travel advice](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice) for Pakistan.

faqs.q: Can I visit family on a Pakistan tourist visa?
faqs.a: Yes. Visiting family or friends is covered by the Pakistan tourist visa.

faqs.q: Can I work in Pakistan on a Pakistan tourist visa?
faqs.a: No. Working needs a work visa or permit. Contact us and we’ll explain the options.

faqs.q: How long does a Pakistan tourist visa take?
faqs.a: Usually a few working days, but processing times vary. Apply at least a week before you travel, and earlier in busy seasons.
